entries.id: Pirates' Fortress Upper Chest as FD

trick.description: Jump along the slope to the side as Fierce Deity to get to the upper chest in Pirates' Fortress Interior.

entries.id: Hookshot Room Skull Flag Rupees With Zora Boomerangs

trick.description: Collect the rupees from the skull flag in the Hookshot room without releasing the bees using Zora Boomerangs through the walls.
Get hurled up to the cow grotto in Great Bay Coast by a Like Like.
Destroy the hives in the Bio Baba grotto in Termina Field with explosives.
Dive for the underwater rupees in springtime Twin Islands as Fierce Deity Link. Simply swim over the items, and hold A.
Long jump to the blue rupees with explosives.
Damage boost off an Octorok projectile as Goron to get the blue rupees on top of the flowers near the swamp frog.

entries.id: Stone Tower Bean Chests as Giant

trick.description: Jump slash to the bean chests as Giant Link.
Perform a Gainer over the sun block blocking Ikana Castle.
Goron Bomb Jump over the sun block blocking Ikana Castle.

any_of: Ikana Castle Invisible Platform Without Lens of Truth

trick.description: Get through the left side of Ikana Castle as Fierce Deity Link, and also jump to the Castle Pillar Heart Piece without Deku Mask.

any_of: Ikana Castle Falling Ceiling Room as Zora/Adult Link
Ikana Castle Falling Ceiling Room as Human

entries.id: Ikana Castle Falling Ceiling Room as Zora/Adult Link

trick.description: Get on top of the falling ceiling as Zora or Adult Link with either a Gainer or a sidehop jump slash, then climb to the switch that unlocks the barred doors.

entries.id: Ikana Castle Falling Ceiling Room as Human

trick.description: Get on top of the falling ceiling with either a Gainer or a sidehop jump slash, raise the ceiling by shooting one of the crystal switches with bow, then ride the ceiling up to the switch that unlocks the barred doors.
Goron Bomb Jump onto the railing of the side of the castle, then navigate along the railing and sidehop to the Piece of Heart.
Jump to the pots in the hole room of Ikana Castle as human, and jump around the Skulltulas while doing the room in reverse.
Jump along the small invisible platforms leading to the Stray Fairy chest at the top of the Map room without Lens of Truth.
Grab the out of bounds item near the entrance to the imprisoned monkey in Deku Palace with a Zora Boomerang through the wall.
Climb around the giant boulder as Giant Link, and into the loading zone.

any_of: Blast Mask Long Jumps As Zora/FD

trick.description: Long jump onto some grabbable terrain as Fierce Deity, then navigate the terrain to sidehop into the racetrack loading zone from above.

entries.id: Goron Racetrack Access With Hookshot/Climb Anywhere

trick.description: Get above the giant boulder in front of the Goron Racetrack, and sidehop into the loading zone.

entries.id: Near Frog Hive Flower as Human

trick.description: Climb onto the giant flower near this beehive as only Human to reach it with Hookshot or a Bombchu. You can do a glitchy upwarp onto the flower from the water where the petals of the flower are as low as they can be.
Destroy this beehive with a well-placed, well-timed Bombchu.
Goron Bomb Jump up to the pots.

entries.id: Deku Palace Pots as Goron With Nothing

trick.description: Wake up a Deku Scrub by backflipping on the Bean Skip door frame, then damage boost up to the Deku Palace pots as Goron off the nuts fired by the Deku Scrub.
Climb up one of the ends of the log to get the item above the log with the gimmick Climb Most Surfaces.
Jump to the invisible item in the gap between the two ramps in northern Termina Field. Requires either a precise long jump+jump slash combo, or a roll jump as a tall form plus a jump slash.
Get on top of the platforms in the Deku Playground during Day 2 or 3 with a well timed jump as Fierce Deity.
Get on top of the platforms in the Deku Playground during Day 2 or 3 with a well timed roll as Goron.
Get on top of the platforms in the Deku Playground during Day 1 with a very precisely timed and aimed Goron Spike Roll.
Hit the clam for its items with a Bombchu, or throw explosives at it.

entries.id: Termina Field Clam With Sword Beams

trick.description: Angle a Sword Beam at the clam in Termina Field using clever targeting of a nearby Chu Chu.

entries.id: Clock Tower Clock With Sword Beams

trick.description: Hit the Clock Tower clock with a Sword Beam for its items, aiming using the nearby dog to angle the beam upward.

entries.id: Clock Tower Clock With Powder Keg

trick.description: Hit the Clock Tower clock for its items by throwing a Powder Keg at it.
Hit the Clock Tower clock for its items using a very, very precise Bombchu.

entries.id: Zora Jar Game With Powder Keg

trick.description: Simply place a Powder Keg in the middle and watch it blow up all the jars at once, winning the game.
Hit the pot with a Sword Beam by summoning the scarecrow and targeting it for a good beam angle.
Break the pot with the Fairy inside with a Bombchu.
Break the pot with the Fairy inside by throwing a Powder Keg at it, either from your pack, or from Medigoron during the Powder Keg Challenge.

entries.id: Road to Ikana Pot as FD

trick.description: Hit the pot with a Sword Beam by summoning the scarecrow and targeting it for a good beam angle.

entries.id: Road to Ikana Pot With Bombchu

trick.description: Break the pot with the Fairy inside with a Bombchu.
Jump to the pot and jump slash it as Fierce Deity.
Break the pot with the Fairy inside with a Bombchu.
Break the pot with the Fairy inside by throwing an explosive at it as Goron/Adult Link.
Break the pot with the Fairy inside by luring a Real Bombchu into it.
Jump to the Piece of Heart as Fierce Deity, with moderate precision required.
Hit Tingle down with a Sword Beam as Fierce Deity. You will need to cleverly utilize a Bombchu to target for the right angle.
Hit Tingle down with a Sword Beam as Fierce Deity. You will need to cleverly utilize a Bombchu or a Guay to target for the right angle.
Hit Tingle down with a Sword Beam as Fierce Deity from the top of the tree.
Jump slash Tingle's balloon in the mountains as Fierce Deity. You don't have to stand on the nearby post to get enough height, but it helps.
Climb up the wall near Tingle with the Climb Most Surfaces gimmick to get in range for a jump slash take down.
Recoil flip from above the Deku Flower to the Ledge Without Tree Chest.
Jump along the platforms to get through the first room as Fierce Deity.
Jump from the Stray Fairy chest spawn in the main room to the 2nd floor as Fierce Deity with egregious precision.
Jump from the 2nd floor to the room with the Gekko as Fierce Deity, and also jump around the elevator room in general.
Use the eye switch elevator without Deku Mask to get to the 2nd floor.
Backflip through the first room, jump to the 2nd floor, jump to the Gekko door, and jump to the Odolwa door, all as Giant Link.
Get through the first room in Woodfall Temple with a highly technical sideways recoil flip as Zora or Adult Link; probably one of the most challenging jumps in all of Casual Logic!
Above the main room, perform a jump slash recoil through one of the holes to obtain access to the main room's 2nd floor.
Kill the carnivorous flower outside the Snapper room, then jump from the flower to the Snapper room.
Long jump to the Small Key chest from the top floor, and long jump to the Snapper room from the elevator.

entries.id: WFT Long Jump to Odolwa as FD

trick.description: In the pre-boss room, jump to the flower platform on the right, then long jump to the Red Rupee on the right with explosives and Fierce Deity to get to Odolwa's lair.
Defeat Odolwa with only Bomb Flowers.

entries.id: WFT Pre-Boss Jumps to Upper Left

trick.description: Jump and climb up the ledges leading to the upper left Stray Fairy bubble as Zora/Adult/Fierce Deity Link.

entries.id: WFT Stray Fairy Bubbles With Explosives

trick.description: Pop Stray Fairy bubbles with explosives and Bombchu, for the purpose of collecting them with Great Fairy's Mask.

requires: WFT Long Jump to Odolwa as FD
any_of: Blast Mask Long Jumps As Zora/FD

entries.id: WFT Poison Water Bubble With Nothing

trick.description: Grab the fairy by swimming in the poison water. It is theoretically possible to not have enough health to do this!
Jump to the switch from the 2nd floor with a roll jump as human.
Use a precise Long Jump to the platform with the chest in the first room. Aim for the Deku Flower to not fall down.
Destroy hives in Woodfall Temple with explosives and Bombchu for their items.

entries.id: WFT Elevator Room Hive Fairy Collection
WFT Entrance Hive With Jump Slash

trick.description: Break the beehive in the first room of Woodfall Temple with a sword and a jump slash.
Long jump to the platform nearest the hive. Also, Adult Link can barely make it there with a precise jump + jump slash.
Jump to the red rupees on the pillars in the room leading up to Odolwa. Can be done with either a Long Jump with explosives, Fierce Deity's Mask Anywhere, or clever use of Ice Arrow platforms.
From the door to Odolwa, roll straight into the pillar as Goron, and the red rupee will somehow be collected.
Long jump to the crystal switch in the room before Odolwa. You will only ever possibly need to do this to collect the red rupee on the right hand side of the room.
Pass the water control room as Giant Link. You can also take the mask off in the water in the whirlpool room to dive to the bottom without Zora Mask.
Skip using the yellow valve in the water control room to activate the yellow pipe's water stream platform, by just jumping across as Fierce Deity Link.

any_of: Blast Mask Long Jumps As Zora/FD

trick.description: Long Jump from the pipe to the red water pump turn key (outside Wart room) with explosives.
Jump to the red water pump turn key (outside Wart room) from below as Fierce Deity Link.

Get to the closed red valve room early by bonking off a nearby wall while dolphin diving out of the water as Zora, and use a Gainer to climb up to the ledge with the turnkey without freezing the Chu Chu.
Jump around the platforms in the room with the Map Chest in Great Bay Temple as Zora/Adult Link/Fierce Deity, or with Long Jumps. In particular, FD can jump to the seesaw room from here.

entries.id: GBT Red Control Turnkey as FD

trick.description: Jump to the platform with the red turnkey in the water control room as Fierce Deity Link from the rising platform on the left.

entries.id: GBT Red Control Turnkey With Bombs

trick.description: Skip needing Hookshot to use the red turnkey in the water control room by recoil flipping to the platform. Alternatively, use a Goron Bomb Jump or a Deku shield recoil.
Jump to the turtle's nose as Fierce Deity with a precise jump from the torches, then strafe around the nose and up onto the turtle's back.
Goron Bomb Jump onto the turtle's nose from the torches Stray Fairy chest, then Goron Bomb Jump onto the turtle's back.

Exit Great Bay Temple with only sticks, if necessary. Jump slash onto the turtle's nose, then you can jump slash around the turtle's eye and onto its back. This trick is very, very unlikely to be required; mostly used to remove exit requirements from Great Bay Temple in Dungeon Entrance Randomizer.

any_of: GBT Green Pump Room Early as FD

entries.id: GBT Green Pump Room Early as FD

trick.description: Jump around the waterstream blocking the ladder to the green pump room as Fierce Deity Link.
Navigate through the waterwheel room without Ice Arrows.
Navigate through the seesaw room without Fire Arrows.
Skip setting up the green pipe water stream platform with a simple jump across the gap to the Great Bay boss door as Fierce Deity Link.

entries.id: GBT Iron Goron Sneaks Past Dexihands

trick.description: Get past the Dexihands between the map chest room and the Bio Baba tunnel by quickly swimming through as human. Also, open the Great Bay Small Key chest by juking out the dexihand there.

requires: Great Bay Compass Chest Room Access
any_of: GBT Boss Key With Ice Arrows

entries.id: GBT Boss Key With Ice Arrows

trick.description: Create an Ice Arrow platform and climb up the window to skip the Gekko fight.

any_of: Blast Mask Long Jumps As Zora/FD

trick.description: Long jump to the Great Bay Boss Key chest with explosives. A tall figure is needed to grab onto the window.
Jump to the exit window for the Great Bay Boss Key chest as Fierce Deity Link.
Jump to the exit window for the Great Bay Boss Key chest with a highly precise diagonal roll jump against the wall as Zora or Adult Link.
As Giant Link, jump slash to the right of the ice blocking the door from near the Small Key chest to get to the Boss Key chest with a bizarre clip.

entries.id: Great Bay Compass Chest Room Access
any_of: GBT Iron Goron Sneaks Past Dexihands

trick.description: Hookshot into most of the rooms of Great Bay Temple with the gimmick Hookshot Any Surface.
Climb into the exit window for the Great Bay Boss Key chest with the gimmick Climb Most Surfaces; requires climbing above the window and jump slashing inside.

entries.id: Great Bay Map Chest Room Access
GBT Stray Fairy Collection With Bombchu

trick.description: Release Stray Fairies in Great Bay Temple from jars, barrels, and bubbles using Bombchu.

entries.id: GBT Water Control Room Underwater Fairy With Nothing

trick.description: Get this fairy with two precise dives from the platform with the Skulltula and the rupee triangle.

entries.id: GBT Pre-Boss Bubble Fairy as Zora

trick.description: Jump out of the water at the Stray Fairy underneath the green turnkey in the room before Gyorg as Zora.

entries.id: Great Bay Temple Pre-Boss Room Access
GBT Pre-Boss Bubble Fairy Recoil Flip

trick.description: Recoil flip into the stray fairy bubble underneath the green turnkey in the room before Gyorg.
Jump to the Stray Fairy chests in the Waterwheel Room as Fierce Deity Link.

entries.id: GBT Waterwheel Fairy Chests With Explosives

trick.description: Long jump to the upper Stray Fairy chest from the rising platform, and recoil flip to the lower Stray Fairy chest from the horizontally moving platform.

entries.id: GBT Waterwheel Room Lower Chest With Nothing

trick.description: Get into the lower cove with the Stray Fairy chest in the waterwheel room with a very precise sidehop and a jump slash.

entries.id: Great Bay Temple Waterwheel Room Access
any_of: Great Bay Compass Chest Room Access

trick.description: Shimmy up the green pipe to get above the ceiling in the green pump room with the gimmick Climb Most Surfaces.

entries.id: Great Bay Temple Seesaw Room Access
any_of: Great Bay Compass Chest Room Access
Great Bay Compass Chest Room Access

trick.description: Break the jar with the Stray Fairy at the bottom of the giant whirlpool with a precise Sword Beam angled by targeting a Bombchu.
Kill all 4 Bio Babas for the Stray Fairy chest with Bombchu.
Blow up the jar holding this Stray Fairy captive, then collect the Fairy with a surviving Dexihand.

entries.id: GBT Green Pump Room Giant Upwarp

trick.description: After entering the green pump room, put on Giant's Mask from a precise position to instantly warp to the ceiling section of the room.
Navigate Snowhead Temple with the gimmick Giant's Mask Anywhere. You can go all the way to the top with just Giant's Mask and a Magic Meter!
Use Gainers in Snowhead Temple to climb ledges that are barely out of reach.
Goron Bomb Jump to ledges that are just barely out of reach in Snowhead Temple.
Cross gaps in Snowhead Temple with Long Jumps.
Get on top of the two blocks stacked on top of eachother with an extremely precise, nuanced Goron Pound that clips into the corner of the block.

entries.id: SHT Bridge Room With Bunny Hood

trick.description: Get past the bridge room with an extremely precise jump and jump slash as human, only possible with Bunny Hood.
Skip using the elevator that requires Fire Arrows with a jump from the crates as Fierce Deity Link.
Jump across the ledges with ramps on the 2nd floor as Fierce Deity Link.
From the first floor, Hookshot the torch in the main room above where the Scarecrow is.
In the Compass room, roll into the switch at the right angle to activate it without thawing the ice.
Jump from the top level of the frozen stairwell to the platform with the 3rd locked door, and also jump from the 3rd locked door to the Goron Pound switch room.
Long jump around the ramps on the 2nd floor in the main room, even if the pillar is raised, with a tall form and precise Long Jump angles.

entries.id: SHT Icicle Room Rupees as Zora

trick.description: Collect the rupees with Zora Boomerangs without breaking the ice.
Collect Stray Fairies in Snowhead Temple by popping the bubbles with explosives or Bombchu.

entries.id: Stump Chest With Goron Bomb Jump

trick.description: Damage boost on top of the stump in Termina Field with a Goron Bomb Jump.
Perform a precise Goron Spike Roll to take a jump off one of the roots of the stump to get on top of the stump.
Damage boost off a nearby Bad Bat as Goron to get on top of the stump.
Climb over the exit game in the maze with the gimmick Climb Most Surfaces enabled.
Navigate through uninverted Stone Tower Temple with the gimmick Giant's Mask Anywhere enabled.
Dolphin dive onto the Eyegore bridge as Zora Link with a precise bonk.
Get on top of the railing or sunblock in the Eyegore room, then Recoil Flip or Long Jump onto the bridge. Alternatively, Goron Bomb Jump onto the bridge from an Ice Arrow ice platform.
Gainer onto the sun block in Stone Tower Temple with sufficiently tall transformations.
Jump onto the Eyegore Bridge as Fierce Deity Link.

entries.id: STT Compass Chest Sun Block Skip

any_of: STT Updraft Room With Powder Keg

trick.description: Recoil flip through the updraft room with explosives.
Jump through the updraft room as Fierce Deity Link.

entries.id: STT Updraft Room With Powder Keg

trick.description: Goron roll through the first updraft to get to the other side, then use a Powder Keg to Recoil Flip through the other 2 sets of updrafts.
Goron roll through the first updraft to get to the other side, then use a Zora Jump Slash recoil to fly through the other 2 sets of updrafts.

entries.id: STT Lava Room Ledge as Zora

trick.description: Perform an incredibly precise Zora Jump Slash in the first updraft to barely make it onto this ledge.

entries.id: STT Lava Room Ledge as Goron

trick.description: Goron roll through the first updraft to get to the other side, then hookshot the chest.

any_of: STT Compass Chest Sun Block Skip

trick.description: Jump slash onto the railing of the bridge, and then cross the water with either Deku Mask, Ice Arrows, or a Recoil Flip.
Defeat the Garo Master in Stone Tower Temple with Deku Sticks.

any_of: STT Basement Ledge Jump Slash Recoil
STT Basement Ledge Jump Slash Recoil
STT Basement Ledge Jump Slash Recoil
STT Basement Ledge Jump Slash Recoil
STT Basement Ledge Jump Slash Recoil

trick.description: From the basement ledge, use a precise curved Recoil Flip to land on top of the sun block.

entries.id: STT Basement Ledge Jump Slash Recoil

trick.description: Get onto the basement ledge by falling down the hole in the ceiling, and using a Jump Slash wall recoil to land on the ledge.

entries.id: STT Basement Ceiling With Real Bombchu

trick.description: Blow up the hole in the ceiling of the basement room with a Real Bombchu from the maze.
Jump Slash the wall in the ceiling hole as Zora Link to recoil off and land on the sun block in the basement.

any_of: STT Basement Ceiling With Real Bombchu
STT Basement Ledge Jump Slash Recoil

trick.description: From the basement ledge, jump on top of the sun block.
Lure the Armos behind the sun block in the basement room closer with Deku Nuts, then kill them through the wall.
Kill the Armos behind the sun block in the basement room with Bombchu.

entries.id: STT Thin Bridge Crystal With Explosives
STT Thin Bridge Crystal as Zora

trick.description: Hit the switch through the floor with Zora Boomerangs.

entries.id: STT Thin Bridge Crystal as FD

trick.description: Jump slash the crystal through the wall as Fierce Deity Link. Alternatively, target the Hiploop and shoot a sword beam at the crystal from below.

entries.id: STT Thin Bridge Crystal With Nothing

trick.description: Jump slash the crystal through the wall with as little as a Deku Stick.
Shoot the underwater sun switch from the uninverted side of the temple with precise timing using a sidehop over the water.

entries.id: STT Underwater Sun Switch With Ice Arrows

trick.description: Shoot the underwater sun switch from the uninverted side on top of an ice platform over the water.
Goron Bomb Jump on top of the sun blocks in the Eyegore room.
Activate the crystal switch in the Eyegore room with explosives through the railing.
Activate the crystal switch in the Eyegore room with Zora Boomerangs through the railing.
Activate the crystal switch in the Eyegore room with as little as a single Deku Stick through the railing, with a precise Jump Slash.

entries.id: STT Bridge Crystal With Spin Attack

trick.description: Activate the crystal switch in the Eyegore room with a big Spin Attack.

entries.id: STT Bridge Crystal With Ice Arrows

trick.description: Make yourself ice platforms with Ice Arrows to get to the area with the crystal switch in the Eyegore room.
Long Jump to the Death Armos switch with explosives.
Jump to the Death Armos switch as Fierce Deity Link.
Navigate through the rooms of Inverted Stone Tower Temple as Giant Link with the gimmick Giant's Mask Anywhere.
Ride the updrafts up without Deku Mask.
Gainer through the upsidedown lava room upstairs with a sufficiently tall transformation.
Recoil flip through the upsidedown lava room upstairs, or Goron Bomb Jump over the short wall.
Recoil Flip from the bridge to either side, including towards the Dexihand, to get launched into the updraft room.
Goron Bomb Jump to the Wizzrobe chest from below.
Cross under the Eyegore bridge with the Deku Flowers by flying underneath the explosives, and flying into them from behind to destroy them.
Jump the gap with the Poes as Fierce Deity Link.

entries.id: ISTT Eyegore Bridge to Dexihand as FD

trick.description: Self-explanatory jump. You may have to try several times before actually getting a proper jump off the bridge.

entries.id: ISTT Recoil Flip to Eyegore Bridge

trick.description: Recoil flip onto the Eyegore bridge from the passage leading out from the updraft room.

entries.id: ISTT Death Armos Maze Chest Recoil Flip

trick.description: Skip needing Elegy or Hookshot for the fire ring in the maze by simply outrunning the returning fire with a recoil flip.

entries.id: Hookshot Room Long Jump to Tank

trick.description: Long jump from the Hookshot chest to the tank with the egg inside.
Navigate through Pirates' Fortress Sewers using Bombchu to hit the crystal switches where available.

entries.id: ISTT Thin Bridge Rupees as Goron

trick.description: Collect the rupees from above by rolling over them as Goron Link.

entries.id: ISTT Frozen Eye Chest Ledge With Nothing

trick.description: Jump to the ledge where the Stray Fairy chest spawns from above with no items.

entries.id: ISTT Thin Bridge Three Blue Rupees as Zora

trick.description: Collect the rupees through the wall with Zora Boomerangs.
Skip the cutscene for Gyorg spawning piranhas by finishing it off with Fierce Deity while it is above the platform.
Kill Gyorg using only Zora Link, and no magic.
Kill Gyorg with only arrows by sidehopping into the water and shooting arrows at it as you fall in.
Kill Gyorg with the Iron Goron gimmick.
Bring Hot Spring Water from the Dexihand to the Well Cow by allowing a Wallmaster to grab you and take you back to the Ikana Castle side of the well.
Get up to the ledge with the two red rupees in the updraft room with a Gainer and a tall transformation.

entries.id: ISTT Updraft Rupee Goron Bomb Jump

trick.description: Get up to the ledge with the two red rupees in the updraft room with a Goron Bomb Jump.
Grab the rupees through the sun block with Zora Boomerangs.
Put on Giant's Mask underneath the chest on the ledge in Bean Man's grotto to get warped up onto the ledge.
Open the chest as Giant from a precise position.
Kill Twinmold with just about any valid damaging hitbox, including just a Kokiri Sword.
Bank Reward #2 will not require Adult Wallet or higher.
Bank Reward #3 will not require Giant Wallet or higher.
Kill the Like Like under the falls in Zora Cape with Bombchu.
Kill the Like-Like under the falls in Zora Cape from a distance, then dive for the item using Giant's Mask to grab it as if it was Ruto's Letter.

Get the Rock Sirloin without lighting the chandelier or the torches. Break the chandelier pot closest to the Baby Goron side with Goron Spikes to get the chandelier swaying slightly, then quickly break the chandelier pot with the Rock Sirloin inside with an extremely precise Goron Spike Roll.

entries.id: SSH Tree Room Beehive as FD

trick.description: Blow up the Gossip Stone in the tree room, then use the blast-off animation of the Gossip Stone to get an angle to hit the beehive with a Sword Beam.

entries.id: Lens Cave With Powder Keg Challenge

trick.description: Bring the Powder Keg from Medigoron across the invisible platforms and into Lone Peak Shrine to blow up the rock. Requires multiple outrageously precise Keg tosses on platforms that you probably can't see; good luck!

Long Jump to the first crystal switch to raise the metal gate. With Blast Mask, you can also hit the second crystal switch to activate the water elevator while simultaneously performing a Long Jump/Recoil Flip to get to the water elevator in time.
Shoot a Sword Beam at Tingle's balloon as Fierce Deity Link. You can get the right angle by targeting the pickaxe guy between him and the rock, on all 3 days.
Climb onto the awning with a precise jump without using a sword to Jump Slash through it.

entries.id: Zora Cape Lower Palm Trees With Ice Arrows

trick.description: Create ice platforms with Ice Arrows and jump to the two lower platforms with the palm trees.
